responsibility: Implements statement-level GIMPLE simplification and constant/range-driven folding used across SSA optimizers. Beyond generic fold_stmt support, it contains the middle-end logic for simplifying assignments, calls, and conditions in GIMPLE form, reasoning about built-in calls, object sizes, string lengths, nonnegativity and integer-valued-real properties, warning-related folding hooks, and constructing replacement statements or values so later passes can propagate constants, remove dead code, and sharpen diagnostics.
same_name_distinction: Provides the implementation of the folding engine declared in gcc/gimple-fold.h: statement and call simplification, constant/range-based folding, builtin-specific rewrites, and warning-oriented queries. In contrast, the header is the public declaration layer with inline convenience wrappers for gimple_build/gimple_convert entry points.
